test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 05
subject: general
question: The term ‘VijAIpatha’ was recently in the news. What does it refer to?

options.text: A national AI policy framework aimed at regulating generative AI content
A CSR initiative to set up AI, STEM and robotics labs in government schools
A Bengaluru based startup incubator for artificial intelligence modelling
An AI integrated digital platform for teacher training, aligned with the National Education Policy 2020, Digital India initiative.

solution:
The correct answer is __**a CSR initiative to set up AI, STEM and robotics labs in government schools.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman launched the ‘VijAIpatha’ initiative in Karnataka.**
 
• **The project aims to democratise access to AI, STEM and robotics education.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **VijAIpatha is a CSR-led national initiative launched under Cyient AI Labs (CyAILS).**
 
• **It focuses on setting up AI, STEM and robotics laboratories in government schools.**
 
• **The pilot project includes five world-class labs in government schools of Karnataka.**
 
• **The initiative targets rural and semi-urban students to build early digital fluency.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **VijAIpatha**__ aligns with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 and Digital India.
 
• Each lab is equipped with AI-ready software, robotics kits, IoT devices and secure broadband.
 
• The programme is expected to benefit over 2,000 students and train more than 200 teachers.
 
• It is envisioned as a scalable CSR model for nationwide expansion of AI education.
